plugins.name: codeqr
plugins.description: CodeQR plugin for creating short links, QR codes, tracking analytics, and managing domains. Integrates the CodeQR API directly into your AI workflow.

skills.name: analytics
skills.description: Query CodeQR analytics data. Use when the user wants to check link clicks, view traffic statistics, see geographic data, analyze device types, or get performance metrics for their short links and QR codes.

skills.name: create-link
skills.description: Create shortened links with CodeQR. Use when the user wants to shorten a URL, create a branded short link, set up link redirects, or generate trackable links with custom slugs, tags, and expiration dates.
headings: Advanced link creation with all options

skills.name: create-qrcode
skills.description: Generate QR codes with CodeQR. Use when the user wants to create a QR code for a URL, customize QR code appearance, or generate branded QR codes with logos and colors.
headings: How to create a QR code

skills.name: manage-domains
skills.description: Manage custom domains in CodeQR. Use when the user wants to add, configure, list, or remove custom domains for their short links.

skills.name: manage-links
skills.description: Manage existing CodeQR short links. Use when the user wants to list, update, delete, or look up information about their short links.

skills.name: manage-tags
skills.description: Manage tags in CodeQR for organizing links. Use when the user wants to create, update, list, or delete tags to categorize their short links and QR codes.

skills.name: track-conversions
skills.description: Track leads and sales conversions in CodeQR. Use when the user wants to set up conversion tracking, log lead events, or record sales attributed to their short links.

commands.name: codeqr
commands.description: Quick access to CodeQR operations — create links, generate QR codes, and check analytics
headings: If no specific action is clear
